channel.title: Law and Crime - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Law and Crime (lawandcrime.com)

item.title: Couple involved in 3 road rage incidents in a month spit on man who was with his kid: Cops
item.description: An Arizona couple allegedly went on a month-long road rage spree including spitting on a man in a Walmart parking lot and throwing rocks at his car with his 8-year-old daughter inside.

item.title: 'He deserved it': Teaching aide 'slammed' special-needs student into window, police say
item.description: Robbin Popour, a teaching aide in Michigan, is accused of slamming a 13-year-old special needs student into a classroom window, saying he "deserved it."

item.title: Man with blood pressure skyrocketing taken to jail instead of hospital, dies: Lawsuit
item.description: California cops killed a man whose blood pressure was skyrocketing to "dangerously" high levels by taking him to jail instead of the hospital after he escaped from an emergency room, a lawsuit says.

item.title: Trump DOJ hears judge loud and clear and finds 'compromise' to end standoff over Alina Habba
item.description: Rather than calling judges "rogue" and "activists," the DOJ turned down the temperature, resulting in an appointment even Alina Habba effusively praised.

item.title: Man shoots wife dead when she asks him to clean before their trip: Police
item.description: A Kentucky man is accused of shooting his wife when she asked him to clean before they left for a trip, leading to her death.

item.title: Man kills his younger brother as their mother begs them to stop fighting
item.description: A Wisconsin man shot his brother in the chest after believing that the victim was being "intimate" with the suspect's wife and wanted to kill him.

item.title: Parents kept starved 13-year-old locked in dog kennel, severely abused other 5 kids: Cops
item.description: Lacy Douglas Hocutt Jr. and Rachelleigh Marie Galasso are accused of severely abusing their six kids, one of whom was kept in a dog kennel

item.title: Man who allegedly swung 13-year-old with autism off a pier will have to face trial
item.description: Tylor Birch and Peyton Carnot allegedly grabbed 13-year-old Jakob Bowerman, who couldn't swim, by his hands and feet and swung him off a pier.

item.title: Man beat his girlfriend's brother 'with a weightlifting bar,' told her to call 911: Prosecutor
item.description: A Michigan man is accused of using a weightlifting bar to hit his girlfriend's brother on the head while the victim was sleeping on the couch.

item.title: Boyfriend who said shooting death of girlfriend was accidental had hurt her before: Police
item.description: Grim new details have been revealed in a case out of Maine where a man is charged with killing his girlfriend with a bullet to her chest, according to police.

item.title: Fed-up FedEx's court demand may mean sleepless nights for Mike Lindell, as legal woes stack up
item.description: FedEx asked a federal judge to issue an order forcing MyPillow CEO Mike Lindell to pay more than $2 million in damages in a lingering shipping debts dispute.

item.title: 'Why are you still breathing?': Man beat his mom, 75, with a metal clamp, cops say
item.description: A man in Long Island, New York, is accused of trying to kill his mother during an argument and exclaiming "why aren't you dying" as he choked her.

item.title: Parents ignored 'obvious signs' 10-month-old was seriously ill before 'avoidable' death
item.description: Matthew Tucker and Cassandra Barlow-Tucker were sentenced to prison for their roles in the preventable death of their 10-month-old foster son.

item.title: Man ripped skin off woman's throat during dinner fight over mac and cheese, police say
item.description: The man was allegedly "upset and told her the macaroni and cheese she made belonged to him."

item.title: Day care worker got hammered during lunch break and fell on top of a child: Police
item.description: Police obtained surveillance video from the day care center and noted that Keosongseng's condition "deteriorated" on the afternoon of Feb. 23.
